patterns.note: Content sections alternate between full-width hero imagery, centered text blocks, and multi-column grids for features or data presentation, often with a clear visual hierarchy.

The site employs a strong sans-serif typeface for all text, featuring oversized, bold headings for impact and clear, readable body text. Uppercase labels are used for sub-headings and navigation items.
A core palette of deep and vibrant greens is used for branding, calls-to-action, and section backgrounds, contrasted with clean white and light grey backgrounds, and dark grey text for readability.
The primary navigation bar transforms from transparent with white text to a solid dark green background with white text and a slightly reduced height as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content sections animate into view with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and guided scroll experience.
Key information is presented in distinct, full-width sections that often alternate background colors (white, light green, dark green) to visually segment content and guide the user down the page.

technique_notes: The navigation bar uses a scroll listener to detect scroll depth, triggering a CSS class change that applies a solid background color, reduces its height, and adjusts text color for contrast.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely orchestrated with GSAP, reveal content sections by applying a subtle fade-in and a slight upward translate effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement without being distracting.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by smaller, highly readable body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — a slight rounding on buttons, cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — the hero section is airy, while subsequent content sections maintain a comfortable, structured density with clear padding between elements.

standout: This site stands out through its confident and empathetic messaging, paired with a clean, professional aesthetic that leverages a distinctive green color palette. The subtle scroll-triggered animations and clear information hierarchy create a trustworthy and engaging user experience without feeling overwhelming.
